cleanup_before_end.reason: railroad-review: run `smine-rules cleanup` for the round before ending the turn
cleanup_before_end.recovery: heartbeat runtime ({finding}): run the round's `smine-rules cleanup`, then end the turn

fix_after_ledger.reason: railroad-review: run `smine-rules ledger --round-dir …` after the round, before the fix-apply stage — its `autofix` set is the fix set
fix_after_ledger.recovery: heartbeat runtime ({finding}): run `smine-rules ledger` for this round, then pass its `autofix` set to fix-apply.js

fixed_after_fix_check.reason: railroad-review: a row becomes fixed only after fix-check.js judged this round's fixes
fixed_after_fix_check.recovery: heartbeat runtime ({finding}): invoke workflows/fix-check.js over the fix commit, then pass its `fixed` ids

fixed_after_replay.reason: railroad-review: a row becomes fixed only after `smine-rules probe-replay` ran against the post-fix head
fixed_after_replay.recovery: heartbeat runtime ({finding}): run `smine-rules probe-replay`, then leave its red finding ids out of `--ids`

next_round_after_fix_check.reason: railroad-review: after fixes land, fix-check.js runs before the next round
next_round_after_fix_check.recovery: heartbeat runtime ({finding}): invoke workflows/fix-check.js over the fix commit, then start the next round

next_round_after_ledger.reason: railroad-review: a new round needs `smine-rules ledger --round-dir …` over the previous round first
next_round_after_ledger.recovery: heartbeat runtime ({finding}): run `smine-rules ledger` for the previous round, then start the next

next_round_after_replay.reason: railroad-review: after fixes land, `smine-rules probe-replay` runs before the next round — a hit goes to the gate
next_round_after_replay.recovery: heartbeat runtime ({finding}): run `smine-rules probe-replay` against the post-fix head; hits go to the gate, then start the next round

no_hunks.reason: railroad-review: the dispatcher never reads diff hunks — `git diff` content stays lane-side (`--numstat`, `--name-only` and `--stat` are fine)
no_hunks.recovery: heartbeat runtime ({finding}): drop the hunk read; use `git diff --numstat` or read the lane artifacts

round_after_lanes.reason: railroad-review: run `smine-rules lanes` before the round — its `lanes` array is the round's lanePlan
round_after_lanes.recovery: heartbeat runtime ({finding}): run `smine-rules lanes`, then pass its `lanes` array as lanePlan

base_plausible.question: Is the resolved base the branch's real fork point — not a stale upstream?
base_plausible.send: heartbeat runtime ({finding}): the runtime agent questions the review base — re-check it before round 1: {evidence}

direction_selection.question: Do the selected directions fit the diff's risk (security for auth or input handling, data-integrity for persisted state)?
direction_selection.send: heartbeat runtime ({finding}): the runtime agent questions the direction selection for this diff: {evidence}

recommendation_fits.question: Does the recommendation fit the round's findings and health — no APPROVE over a red base, no CONDITIONAL over an empty plan?
recommendation_fits.send: heartbeat runtime ({finding}): the runtime agent questions this round's recommendation: {evidence}

tiering.question: Do the lane count and lane model fit the diff size and risk?
